posts.title: Comments Considered Harmful
posts.description: Coding agents are quick to synthesise comments from context, but bad at reading and maintaining them, which makes every comment a mine waiting for the next agent to trip.

posts.title: AI operations is a mirage
posts.description: AIs are remarkably good at putting together code, but the same problems can 10x the wreckage of your environment when applied to operations because production doesn't have the same guardrails.

posts.title: ocgtk development update: June 2026
posts.description: Development update for ocgtk (a set of GTK4 bindings for OCaml), including upcoming support for signals and interfaces, expanded GLib type coverage, and packaging improvements to support other operating systems.
